name: Hex
summary: Curses a creature to take extra Necrotic damage from your hits and to falter on one ability's checks.

m.text: the petrified eye of a newt

stats.effect:
You place a curse on a creature that you can see within range. Until the spell ends, you deal an extra 1d6 Necrotic damage to the target whenever you hit it with an attack roll. Also, choose one ability when you cast the spell. The target has {ref:glossary/disadvantage} on ability checks made with the chosen ability.

If the target drops to 0 {ref:glossary/hit-points} before this spell ends, you can take a {ref:glossary/bonus-action} on a later turn to curse a new creature.
stats.higherLevels: Your {ref:glossary/concentration} can last longer with a spell slot of level 2 (up to 4 hours), 3–4 (up to 8 hours), or 5+ (24 hours).
